claims.text: jiant implements over 50 NLU tasks, including all GLUE and SuperGLUE benchmark tasks.
jiant supports a variety of NLU tasks such as MNLI, CommonsenseQA, and SQuAD.
jiant provides a configuration-driven interface for defining experiments using over 50 NLU tasks.
